name: Claude Mythos 5.1
tagline: Claude Fable 5.1 with lighter safeguards — invitation-only through Project Glasswing, released September 2026.
metaDescription: Claude Mythos 5.1 is Anthropic's invitation-only Mythos-class model from September 2026 — same specs and pricing as Claude Fable 5.1, with lighter safeguards.
overview: Claude Mythos 5.1 is the restricted-access half of Anthropic's 1 September 2026 Mythos-class release. It is the same underlying model as Claude Fable 5.1, carrying the same specifications and pricing, but ships with lighter safeguards aimed at work in cybersecurity and the life sciences. Anthropic offers it by invitation only through Project Glasswing, limited to US organizations in its Cyber Verification Program and Life Sciences Verification Program; access runs through an Anthropic, AWS or Google Cloud account team.

Because it shares the Claude Fable 5.1 model, Claude Mythos 5.1 has a 1M-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, text and image input, and adaptive thinking that is always on with a default effort of high. Pricing matches Claude Fable 5.1 at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, with cache reads at $0.25 per million.

Anthropic reports that the lighter safeguards change how often the model declines benign work: biology safeguards trigger 85% less frequently on benign medical queries, and cybersecurity safeguards show 60% fewer false positives per session. Anthropic also states that the model can identify software vulnerabilities for defensive work.

Anthropic published several scientific results for Claude Mythos 5.1. On three targets it designed protein binders whose binding affinities were 10 times higher than the best designs submitted to Adaptyv Bio's protein design competitions, with a hit rate of nearly 50% across 12 targets. It produced a Venus elevation map resolving details down to two to three kilometres rather than 10 to 20, with heights up to 25% more accurate. Using custom GPU kernels and cached intermediate results, it sped up seven open-source deep learning models by up to 2.5 times with identical outputs. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, Anthropic reports Claude Mythos 5.1 at 60.9%, above the 55.8% it reports for Claude Fable 5.1.

faq.q: How do I get access to Claude Mythos 5.1?
faq.a: Claude Mythos 5.1 is invitation-only through Project Glasswing. Anthropic limits it to US organizations enrolled in its Cyber Verification Program and Life Sciences Verification Program, and directs interested customers to contact their Anthropic, AWS or Google Cloud account team. There is no self-serve route: Claude Fable 5.1 is the generally available version of the same model.

faq.q: How is Claude Mythos 5.1 different from Claude Fable 5.1?
faq.a: Claude Mythos 5.1 and Claude Fable 5.1 are the same underlying model with different levels of safeguards. Mythos 5.1's safeguards are designed to support cybersecurity and life-sciences work, so it declines fewer benign requests in those areas and can identify software vulnerabilities for defensive purposes. The two share specifications and pricing.

faq.q: How much does Claude Mythos 5.1 cost?
faq.a: Claude Mythos 5.1 shares Claude Fable 5.1's pricing: $10 per million input tokens, $50 per million output tokens, and cache reads at $0.25 per million tokens. Anthropic's model page states that Mythos 5.1 shares Fable 5.1's specifications and pricing, so the context window of 1M tokens and 128K max output apply too.

faq.q: What scientific results has Anthropic published for Claude Mythos 5.1?
faq.a: Anthropic reports that Claude Mythos 5.1 designed protein binders with binding affinities 10 times higher than the best entries in Adaptyv Bio's protein design competitions on three targets, with a hit rate near 50% across 12 targets. It also built a Venus elevation map resolving two to three kilometres instead of 10 to 20, and sped up seven open-source deep learning models by up to 2.5 times.
